title: MI60036: Fluid Power In Mining Machinery
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic concepts, compression processes, Compressor types, inter-coolers, aftercoolers and receivers, valves, transmission of compressed air through pipeline
Fundamentals of hydraulic transmission, hydraulic fluids, hydraulic pumpsfixed and variable displacement types, pressure, flow and direction control
devices, hydraulic power cylinders and motors, hydraulic servo systems,
hydraulic circuits and their applications in excavation and heavy earth moving
machinery.
